aboutMe.firstParagraph: Professionally coding since 2020. I bridge the gap between a robust backend (<Highlight>Java</Highlight>, <Highlight>Spring</Highlight>) and a modern frontend (<Highlight>React</Highlight>, <Highlight>TypeScript</Highlight>). I care about <Highlight>clean architecture</Highlight>, good design, and solid craftsmanship—no shortcuts or sloppy work.

webApplicationDeveloper.description: I create web applications by combining frontend and backend. I design user interfaces and implement business logic, ensuring interactivity and responsiveness. I have experience with architectures based on both <Highlight>synchronous and asynchronous communication</Highlight>.

qualityDrivenDeveloper.description: In order to ensure high code quality and reduce the number of emerging errors, I ensure that applications are well-tested using <Highlight>unit and integration tests</Highlight>. Thanks to this approach, the applications I work on are more reliable and easier to maintain.

cleanCodePractitioner.description: I write clear and understandable code, adhering to the best programming practices. Throughout my career, I always strive to follow practices such as <Highlight>SOLID, KISS, DRY, YAGNI</Highlight>, as well as many other good practices advocated by Uncle Bob (Bob Martin).

refactoringNinja.description: I specialize in improving existing code, removing unnecessary elements, and optimizing its structure, ensuring its readability and efficiency. Following the theory of broken windows, I strive to prevent <Highlight>'broken windows'</Highlight> from occurring.

architectureEnthusiast.description: I am passionate about computer system architecture and I aim to delve into the intricacies of software design, creating scalable, efficient, and flexible systems using <Highlight>Domain-Driven Design (DDD)</Highlight> practices.

programingPassion.description: Programming is not just a profession for me, but a passion that engages my mind and provides constant challenges. I find beauty in the simplicity of code and satisfaction in solving problems.

seniorsoftwareengineer.resp2: Designing and implementing a public <Highlight>RESTful API (HATEOAS)</Highlight> for external integrations, including <Highlight>MCP integration</Highlight> to enable seamless data exchange with AI agents.
seniorsoftwareengineer.resp3: Architectural refactoring using the <Highlight>Ports & Adapters</Highlight> pattern, enabling consistent domain logic to be safely and flexibly exposed through both the public API and the UI.
seniorsoftwareengineer.resp4: Providing <Highlight>technical leadership</Highlight> and product support by delivering solutions aligned with core business objectives.
seniorsoftwareengineer.resp5: Mentoring team members, driving <Highlight>engineering best practices</Highlight>, and maintaining high standards of code quality.

softwareengineer.resp5: Maintaining and optimizing <Highlight>CI/CD pipelines</Highlight> to ensure release stability and high software quality.

internsoftwaredeveloper.resp5: Developing analytical thinking and problem-solving skills through hands-on technical projects.

description.paragraph1: During my studies, I had the opportunity to delve into various aspects of computer science, including <Highlight>software design</Highlight>, <Highlight>computer networks</Highlight>, <Highlight>databases</Highlight>, and <Highlight>algorithms</Highlight>. I participated in numerous team projects, which allowed me to develop collaboration skills and problem-solving abilities within a group. Working in a team on various IT projects enriched my experience.
description.paragraph2: As part of my diploma thesis, I developed an application for <Highlight>managing household finances</Highlight>. The project included the implementation of the user interface and application logic, along with comprehensive infrastructure. The diploma thesis was supplemented with detailed documentation, which thoroughly describes all aspects of the application and its creation process.
description.paragraph3: Additionally, throughout my academic journey, I had the honor of receiving the <Highlight>rector's scholarship for top students</Highlight>.

description.paragraph1: During my studies, I obtained three qualifications:
description.e12: Assembly and operation of personal computers and peripheral devices,
description.e13: Designing local computer networks and network administration,
description.e14: Creating web applications and databases and administering them,
description.paragraph2: Throughout my studies, I received a scholarship under the <Highlight>'Young Engineer'</Highlight> program.
